coverage.evaluation: GH and symptomatic perineal-body deficiency considered, but 3.5-cm selection threshold is study-specific and not validated for universal surgery.
coverage.treatment: Practical perineal reconstruction preserved; posterior repair, obstetric reconstruction and isolated perineorrhaphy distinguished. No demonstrated recurrence-prevention effect.
coverage.numbers: Swieten selection OR, Mothes/Bonglack GH, Rotstein symptoms, Sutkin posterior repair, Blomquist incident POP, Siff postoperative risk and Cervantes retention scoped to their actual populations/designs.
coverage.doseDeviceSafety: No drug/device dose; urinary retention defined by discharge catheter after failed voiding trial and dyspareunia caution retained without causal incidence claim.
coverage.anatomyTechnique: Kanter survey and Bonglack operative Methods support variant techniques; DeLancey triad labeled hypothesis, Kochová fractions qualified as postmenopausal samples.
coverage.followUp: Bonglack three months, Rotstein one year, Mothes postoperative interval from abstract, OPTIMAL two years and protocol without results distinguished.

coverage.references: All 24 inherited entries preserved; Blomquist author attribution corrected. ACOG PB214 kept bibliographically but not used for unverified specific operative language.
